headline: The 30-year Treasury yield just hit a 19-year high. Three things could drive it even higher
detail: Rising yields increase borrowing costs for companies and make future earnings less attractive, directly impacting growth stocks like tech and chips. This creates headwinds for your concentrated portfolio.
rec: Consider trimming highly leveraged or deeply underwater positions like SOXL and SPAL to reduce overall portfolio risk in this environment.

headline: Credit card issuer Synchrony announces partnership with OpenAI
detail: This highlights continued integration of AI across industries. While not directly impacting your holdings, it signals ongoing tech innovation and potential for AI-related names in the broader market.
rec: No direct action on your holdings, but keep an eye on broader AI developments for future opportunities.

headline: South Korea must brace for ‘worst-case scenario,’ President Lee says, as Trump cuts military drills
detail: Geopolitical tensions in Asia can impact global supply chains, especially for semiconductors, which are a core part of your portfolio. This adds an element of uncertainty.
rec: No immediate trade, but monitor geopolitical developments, especially those affecting chip manufacturing and supply chains.
